title: A broadcast whose first copy is just over 30 minutes before a receipt cannot be the fallback's position there, but is still read for the precise flag
reasoning: ADR 0003 at bfe51aa records Casey's answer (issue #55 comment 6995037213, item 3): "A broadcast's gateway copies count as one position, timed by the first copy, precise if any copy qualifies." Its early-edge sentences: "When the copies straddle the edge of a window the rules read, the whole broadcast counts as inside or outside by its first copy." and "At the 30-minute fallback's early edge, such a broadcast cannot be the position the fallback chooses, but it is still read, so it still counts toward the precise flag of the cell it lies in."

c55-ra's broadcast, packet 55003, cell D at 20 bits (1000.3 m north of c20 by stored values), reached c55-h1 on the public broker at 23 09:59:50 (c55-m003) and c55-h2 on MeshSTL only at 10:00:10 (c55-m004): one position, timed 09:59:50, qualifying through c55-m004. c55-ra also sent c20 on the public broker at 22 09:05 (c55-m002) and at 23 10:59:55 (c55-m005). The copies' gateways are not c55-g and the rows have no relay_node, so they are no receipts and make no candidate at c55-g.

c55-ra's receipts are at 10:30, 10:35 and 10:40. Each look-back holds c55-m002 (c20) and the broadcast (D), which neither overlap nor lie within 40 m, so c55-ra is not stationary and takes the fallback at every receipt. At 10:30 the window runs from 10:00:00 to 11:00:00: the broadcast, timed 09:59:50, is 10 seconds outside it and cannot be chosen, and the only position inside is c55-m005, 29 minutes 55 seconds after. At 10:35 and 10:40 c55-m005 is again the only position within 30 minutes. Every receipt's box is c20.

c55-ra has no hour box (not stationary), each receipt keeps its own, all c20, and c55-g is on its hour box g16: one box per end, kept. relayer_precise_source is false: the covered cell c20 was read only in c55-m002 and c55-m005, both public; the broadcast is read through the look-back, but its cell D is not covered.

c55-ra's hour fails both readings ADR 0003 rules out. Timed by its later copy, the broadcast would be at 10:00:10, 29 minutes 50 seconds before the 10:30 receipt and nearer than c55-m005: the fallback would take it, that receipt's box would be D (3021.475856 m to g16, passing lnk_05) while the others use c20, and step 8 would drop the hour on lnk_02. Counted copy by copy, c55-m004 at 10:00:10 would be taken the same way and the hour dropped the same way.

c55-rb's broadcast, packet 55010, cell c20, reached c55-h1 publicly at 23 10:59:50 (c55-m010) and c55-h2 on MeshSTL only at 11:00:10 (c55-m011): one position, timed 10:59:50, qualifying through c55-m011. c55-rb also sent D on the public broker at 22 09:05 (c55-m009) and c20 on the public broker at 23 11:33 (c55-m012).

c55-rb's receipts are at 11:30, 11:35 and 11:40. Each look-back holds D and the broadcast (c20), so c55-rb is not stationary. At 11:30 the broadcast is 10 seconds before the window's early edge (11:00:00) and cannot be chosen; c55-m012, 3 minutes after, is taken at every receipt, so every box is c20, one box per end, kept. The broadcast lies in every receipt's 7-day look-back, which the fallback's precise flag reads (PLAN, Data model; c44), and its cell is c20, the covered cell: relayer_precise_source is true. c55-rb pins the ADR's "still read"; it gives the same answers under the two readings the ADR rules out, since a later copy is still inside the look-back.
gateway_precise_source is false in both hours: c55-g's only cell has 16 bits and was sent on the public broker.

Every receipt is a direct hop (relay_node is the relayer's own byte, lnk_01) and passes lnk_05 at 2745.603337 m from c20 to g16, boxes not overlapping. Each hour has 3 packets: kept. Medians: SNR 5, 6 and 7 dB give 6.0; RSSI -90, -95 and -100 dBm give -95.0. position_uncertainty_m is c20's 22.734410 m plus g16's 363.750397 m, = 386.484807 m (lnk_05).
